messages:
Alex (AE): Quick sync - ACME ready to issue PO but legal returned DPA + HSM attestation asks. Need signature routing and AP-friendly orderform. Who can confirm timelines?
Priya (Legal): Reviewed their redlines. Key asks: EU data residency clause, HSM attestation, and a shorter cure period on SLA. We can accept most DPA edits but need to propose alternative indemnity language for section 7.2.
Marco (Finance): Net45 payment terms acceptable. For AP integration we need: PO number, remit-to address, VAT number, and a JSON orderform template they can ingest. Also confirm billing contact and invoice email.
Sam (SE): HSM options: Dedicated/Private supports BYOK with customer KMS. Hosted gets our vendor-managed HSM (Thales) and we can provide an attestation letter. Standard attestation lead time ~3-5 business days. If they want SOC2+HSM combo, allow 5 bd. Suggest orderform includes a fallback KeyMgmt option if attestation delayed.
ACME Procurement: We need the orderform as a single-line JSON for our AP tool. Region must be eu-west-1, SLA target 99.9, monthly commitment, and billing contact payables@acmecorp.com. Also need the HSM vendor name and whether keys are customer-controlled.
Alex (AE): Draft JSON orderform (copy-paste into their AP):
```json
{"customer":"ACME Corporation","order_id":"<PO_NUMBER>","product":"Redwood Dedicated","region":"eu-west-1","commitment_months":12,"instances":4,"monthly_amount":"120000","billing_contact":"payables@acmecorp.com","invoice_email":"invoices@acmecorp.com","support_sla":"99.9","kms_mode":"vendor-hsm","hsm_vendor":"Thales","hsm_attestation_timeline_days":5}
```
Priya (Legal): I'm drafting MSA patch to accept EU residency and to add a DPA exhibit with subprocessor list. Will propose softer cure period compromise and alternative indemnity wording. contracts-bot: uploaded /contracts/ACME/MSA_patch_v2.pdf by @Priya.
contracts-bot: Document uploaded: MSA_patch_v2.pdf  reviewer=Priya (Legal).
Nina (Ops): E-sign routing: DocuSign envelope to be sent to legal@redwood.com and finance@redwood.com for countersign. If ACME insists on wet-ink, route to @sales-lead for exec approval to print/scan. We can include envelope metadata with PO number.
ACME Procurement: Can you confirm if keys remain under our control (BYOK) or if Redwood manages keys? Also, will the attestation be a signed letter on company letterhead?
Sam (SE): For Dedicated/Private: BYOK = yes, customer retains key control. For Hosted: Redwood-managed HSM (Thales). We can provide a signed attestation letter. If they need HSM inventory + crypto-module certs, that's extra and may need 7-10 bd.
Marco (Finance): After we get the PO and the completed JSON orderform, route invoices@redwood.com and cc marco@redwood.com. I'll create the billing account with net45 and the provided VAT.
Alex (AE): Plan: 1) Priya posts final MSA/DPA + subproc list today; 2) I send the one-line JSON orderform and DocuSign envelope; 3) Marco finalizes billing record on PO receipt. Will tag when envelope sent. :rocket:
Priya (Legal): Uploading DPA exhibit and subproc list now, will note the indemnity clause alternative.
Marco (Finance): Ack. Waiting on PO and confirmed invoice email.
Alex (AE): Thanks all. If attestation ETA slips, we'll include the fallback kms_mode field in the orderform and mark attestation_pending=true. @Priya please add sign-off line for DocuSign. :thumbsup:
